description: Updates a MATERIAL rate table at the project level — general info and/or column membership — propagating the same edit to its company parent. Material-only: any other resource_category returns 403.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the company

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the project

parameters.name: rate_table_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the rate table

id.description: Unique identifier of the rate table

is_active.description: Whether the rate table is active

created_by.description: Login of the user who created the rate table

updated_by.description: Login of the user who last updated the rate table

columns.description: Array of rate columns associated with this rate table

project_ids.description: Array of project IDs where this rate table has been copied. Only present for company-level rate tables.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

name.description: Name of the rate table (max 200 characters)

effective_date.description: Effective date and time of the rate table (ISO 8601 datetime format required)

expiration_date.description: Expiration date and time of the rate table (ISO 8601 datetime format required)

column_ids.description: Final list of rate column IDs to be present in the rate table
